# مبتعث - Mobt3ath

> > Academic research and consulting platform serving Saudi universities with thesis writing, Scopus indexing, translation, and statistical analysis services.

Mobt3ath (مبتعث للدراسات والاستشارات الاكاديمية) provides comprehensive academic support services for researchers and students across Saudi universities, with particular focus on Shaqra University and institutions throughout the Kingdom. The platform specializes in scientific publishing, research consultation, and academic writing services aligned with Saudi Ministry of Education standards.

## Key Topics

- Scopus Indexing & Publishing
- Thesis & Dissertation Writing
- Saudi Universities (جامعة شقراء, وزارة التعليم)
- Academic Research Services
- Scientific Journals & Publishing
- Statistical Analysis
- Translation Services
- Academic References & Citations
- Predatory Journal Identification
- Research Consulting
- Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Academic Standards
- Shaqra University Region (شقراء, حريملاء, القويعية, الدوادمي)
- Scientific Research Methodology
- Academic Writing Support
- Research Publication Guidance

## Core Academic Services

- [مبتعث للدراسات والاستشارات الاكاديمية](https://mobt3ath.com/det.php): Academic studies & consulting services for Saudi universities & Scopus
- [Academic Services Overview](https://mobt3ath.com/dets.php): Academic services: thesis, translation, statistical analysis & consulting

## Research & Search Tools

- [Academic Search](https://mobt3ath.com/serche.php): Search results for academic journals & research in Saudi universities
